A Day in Ancient Egypt — one still per timestamp

Ninety-five 16:9 stills, one for every timestamp in the script, drawn in the same deliberately clumsy MS-Paint hand: white ground, thick wobbly outlines, stick figures, flat fills, red arrows for emphasis.

95 stills 95 timestamps 16:9 · 2048×1152 PNG Runtime 0:00 → 9:32

Timestamps are stitched. The second transcript restarted at 0:00. Part 1 ends at 5:32, so every part 2 timestamp is shifted by +5:39 and the numbering below runs continuously from 0:00 to 9:32. Part 2’s 0:00 is now 5:39, its 1:00 is 6:39, and so on.
